metrics.profile_summary: Performance-driven marketing professional with approximately 5 years of experience specializing in paid media and digital strategy. Proven track record in managing multi-platform ad campaigns and currently leading a marketing team to optimize ROI and brand visibility.

experience.description: Leads marketing campaigns, supervises content creation, manages influencer ROI, and oversees budget allocation across Meta, Google, Snapchat, and TikTok.
Developed and executed Meta/Google ad strategies, performed A/B testing, and provided data-driven insights to maximize client ROI.
Created high-quality content and managed paid social media campaigns, utilizing quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends.
Optimized Meta ad campaigns and implemented Meta Pixel for accurate tracking, retargeting, and performance measurement.
Managed product listings with SEO optimization, conducted market research, and oversaw end-to-end order fulfillment and logistics.

strengths: Current experience in a leadership role
weaknesses: Does not meet the 2-3 year people management requirement
Total experience is on the lower end of the 5-7 year requirement
evaluation.summary: Strong technical performance marketer with a solid academic foundation. While he lacks the extensive management tenure required, his current role as Team Lead and deep expertise in paid channels make him a viable candidate for a growth-oriented manager role.
